02Why Scout exists

Strategists spend the day gathering context.

The bottleneck is not analysis. It is the hours between a competitor headline landing in a group chat and a testable hypothesis arriving in the planning doc. That translation, from signal to sized bet, is the highest leverage hour a manager spends. Today it lives in slides and messages.

Scout compresses it. Reads the week's signals against Grab's stated goals, drafts a hypothesis in the team's own vocabulary, hands over a bet portfolio the team can nudge, override, or kill. Strategist stays in the driver's seat. Scout runs the plumbing.

Human judgment stays essential. AI can accelerate and bring greater rigor to the work of strategy teams, playing five distinct roles across the design phase. From a Feb 2025 industry paper on AI in strategy development

04The four strategist roles inside

Scout plays four roles at once.

One pipeline, four narrow specialists. Each maps to a role a strategist plays. Each enforced by more than a prompt.

01 · RESEARCHER

Signal reader

Scans the week's news, competitor movements, financial disclosures. Filters against Grab's stated goals and its competitive set.
What makes it rigorous Curated competitor registry and a market reference library, both maintained outside the model. Signals deduped and time-bounded. Cannot invent a competitor that is not in the registry.
02 · INTERPRETER

Prize sizer

Translates a signal into what it moves. Names the stated goal, walks the driver math, cascades the delta up to Group Adj EBITDA.
What makes it rigorous Hardcoded library of Grab's goals and financial drivers, sourced from Q1 and Q2 2026 earnings. Model proposes numbers, the deterministic layer enforces which drivers exist and how they roll up.
03 · THOUGHT PARTNER

Framer and critic

Considers three framings before drafting. Self-critiques the hypothesis to name the weakest joint before a human has to.
What makes it rigorous Framing pass capped at four visible steps, each nudgeable. Critic pass structured as a pre-mortem: structural counter-argument, load-bearing assumption, kill signal with a metric threshold.
04 · COMMUNICATOR

Bets and pilot writer

Turns the hypothesis into four bets and one designed pilot. Cost, horizon, feasibility, baseline, threshold, kill, risks.
What makes it rigorous Every bet typed (financial vs execution). Pilot template enforces a decision rule with an ambiguous zone. No bet without a driver anchor, no pilot without a kill threshold.
05How Scout thinks, end to end

Four roles running in sequence.

Grounded inputs feed a chain of specialists. Deterministic guardrails around each stage. The human nudges any step and the pipeline re-runs from there with prior context intact.

06Part of a bigger portfolio

Scout is one of five agents.

Growth & Planning is not one job. It is design, mobilization, and execution. Specialized agents that hand off to each other. Scout is the first, focused on the design phase.

07Live now & what unlocks next

Working today

  • End-to-end pipelineSignals through Framer, Estimator, Critic, Bets, Pilot. All four tabs connected.
  • Two fully worked hypothesesAMP + Atome Convergence, Priority Deliveries Ads Flywheel. Grab's arithmetic throughout.
  • Live reasoningFour visible steps with nudge and re-run gates at every stage.
  • Voice disciplineGrab's own vocabulary and insider references, not consultant language.
  • Working filtersSector, market, competitor, 12-month window. Multi-competitor signals split individually.

The next unlock

  • Deeper source libraryWire in earnings-call transcripts, app-review sentiment, job-post velocity as leading indicators.
  • Learning loopWhen the team marks a hypothesis Live, Kill, or Watch, feed the outcome back so Scout learns which framings get acted on.
  • Cross-hypothesis viewTwo-by-two of active hypotheses on impact versus feasibility. Coverage gaps visible at a glance.
  • Push modeWeekly scan that flags when a new signal changes an active hypothesis's arithmetic. Proactive, not just on demand.
  • Multi-market variantsSame reasoning per-market. PH-specific and TH-specific hypotheses inherit group-level rigor.
